limitations: Only seven validation and seven held-out videos; numerous validation comparisons produce selection optimism.
The test split was previously evaluated by a CPU comparator, but was not used for Qwen tuning.
Exact duplicates are grouped; camera/session independence is not established.
Binary agreement does not establish actor, event-type, rule-applicability or localization correctness.
Nearest-anchor error is not semantic event matching and is computed only on detected positive videos.
Historical timing summaries used the upper middle value for even sample counts. This export recomputes the conventional median without modifying original reports.
Human annotations are free text, not exhaustive per-rule event labels.
